text:
Jamie P: Customer reported intermittent 401s right after they rotated their API key. Happens in our Python sampleapp only.
Jamie P: Steps: rotate key in console, `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk-live-NEW`, restart sampleapp. After ~10s the app throws 401s for a minute then recovers.
Jamie P: Snippet from app logs:
```
2025-06-12T14:02:15Z ERROR request failed status=401 url=/v1/generate
2025-06-12T14:02:15Z INFO auth: using cached key metadata (org=acme)
2025-06-12T14:02:20Z INFO auth: refresh credentials succeeded
2025-06-12T14:02:20Z INFO retrying request
```
Theo R: Sounds like the Python SDK has a process-local cache of key -> metadata and doesn't invalidate on env change. We only invalidate on explicit `client.invalidate()` calls today.
Nina S: Could also be TTL on cached signed-credentials. If the service returns 401 we should try a forced refresh before backoff.
Jamie P: Customer restarted the app, but the problem begins during rotation when some requests still flow through old worker processes.
Theo R: Two action items: (1) Make SDK retry path do a refresh on 401 (idempotent) before giving up. (2) Add a small filewatch/hot-reload hook in sampleapp that clears credential cache when `$REDWOOD_API_KEY` file or env changes.
Nina S: Agree. Also add a diagnostic log when using cached metadata so we can triage faster. `debug: auth cache hit for key=****`
OpsBot: Created ticket INF-739: "python-sdk: force refresh on 401 and env-change cache invalidation" assigned to @Theo R. https://tracker.redwood/INF-739
Theo R: I'll open a tiny PR with the 401 refresh first, add unit tests and an integration that flips env-var mid-run.
infra-ci: CI passed for branch `fix/auth-refresh-401` (tests=42/42)
Jamie P: I'll loop back to the customer and share the workaround: restart all workers after rotation or set `REDWOOD_CRED_RELOAD=1` (temp flag we added to sampleapp).
Nina S: Nice. Let's also include a note in the docs about rotation best-practices and sampleapp flags.
Jamie P: Thanks team, marking as P2 until the PR lands then we'll bump if we see more customers. :white_check_mark:
